answer_1.quote: We conduct a systematic evaluation to investigate the translationese patterns exhibited by LLMs and examine the underlying causes of these unexpected unnatural translations...

answer_2.quote: We use both automatic and human evaluation metrics to assess the translation naturalness. Automatic Evaluation... we consider two additional metrics: lexical density (Lex.) and length variance (Len.)... For translation quality estimation, we utilize Unbabel/wmt22-cometkiwi-da to compute and report COMET-QE scores...

answer_4.quote: we request three expert translators to identify and annotate segments containing translation errors... We ask the three expert translators to rank translations generated by different models...
answer_4.guideline: Identify and annotate spans exhibiting translationese errors (unnatural sentence flow and unnatural phrase flow) or rank translations based on naturalness.
